The gift of time back

Some people already have everything they need. What almost nobody has is a free afternoon. Looking for a house cleaning gift card in Richardson? A gift card from Salt of the Earth Cleaning Co. gives someone you care about a fresh, clean home without lifting a finger, from a locally owned team that takes its time on the details.

"Everything looks and feels so fresh and cared for!" — K. McGee

Who it's perfect for

  • New parents. Sleepless nights leave no time for bathrooms and floors. A clean home is one less thing to think about.
  • Friends and family on the move. Help with a move-in / move-out clean on one of the most stressful weeks of the year.
  • The holidays. A gift that's actually useful, before the guests arrive or after they leave.
  • Birthdays and thank-yous. For the parent, grandparent or friend who always takes care of everyone else.
  • Pet owners. Our pet-friendly house cleaning goes after the dog and cat hair, using eco-friendly, pet-safe products.

How to buy a gift card

We don't sell gift cards online. To buy one, just reach out:

Call: (469) 210-8005

Email: info@sotecleaning.com

Tell us who it's for and what you'd like to give, and we'll take care of the details. We're open Monday through Sunday, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM.

Ideas for what to give

Not sure what to choose? Tell us about the person and their home when you call. A standard clean is a great everyday refresh, a deep clean reaches the baseboards, ceiling fans, grout and the inside of the oven and fridge, and a one-time clean is perfect before a big event or holiday visit.

Every team member is background checked, our cleaners speak English, and we're 5.0-star rated on Google, so you can feel good about who's coming into their home.

We clean homes all over Dallas–Fort Worth, so the gift works for homes across DFW.
